name: FwHunt rules
description: YAML FwHunt rule corpus for known UEFI vulns/threats; used with fwhunt-scan.
access_constraints: Public (CC0). Rules only — not full firmware images.

name: fwhunt-scan test fixtures
description: Community scanner plus sample rules/tests for EFI module and firmware image scanning.
access_constraints: Public. Sample binaries limited; bring your own firmware for real scans.

name: DVUEFI deliberately vulnerable images
description: Damn Vulnerable UEFI lab stages for teaching firmware exploitation (QEMU then VMware).
access_constraints: Public GitHub; recursive clone. Lab/teaching use.

name: UIUCTF-2022 SMM Cowsay challenges
description: Three SMM Cowsay pwn challenges (levels 1–3) from UIUCTF 2022.
access_constraints: Public challenge sources/images in CTF public repo.

name: efi-whitelist vendor EFI executable corpus metadata
description: ~1.9M known EFI executable records extracted from vendor update images for CHIPSEC whitelist module.
access_constraints: Public JSON metadata (hashes/names), not full PE bodies.

name: LVFS / fwupd firmware corpus
description: Linux Vendor Firmware Service public capsule/update corpus; FwHunt scanned ~650k EFI binaries from ~5k uploads historically.
access_constraints: Public downloads via LVFS/fwupd CDN; redistribution of some vendor blobs may be restricted by vendor license. Rate limits apply.

name: Binarly Vulnerability-REsearch advisories corpus
description: Large set of Binarly UEFI/SMM vulnerability advisories and writeups (BRLY-*).
access_constraints: Public GitHub documentation; not a binary dump.

name: CERT/CC UEFI Analysis Resources
description: Example materials including CVE-2021-28216 analysis resources for UEFI.

name: quarkslab/pixiefail PoC suite
description: Scapy-based PoCs triggering PixieFail EDK2 IPv6/NetworkPkg vulns.
access_constraints: Public; requires vulnerable EDK2/NetworkPkg build or affected firmware in lab.

name: d3ctf-2022-pwn-d3guard SMM CTF
description: SMM/UEFI CTF challenge sources referenced by awesome-uefi-security (also corCTF smm-diary, Dubhe ToySMM).
access_constraints: Mixed: some public GitHub, some CTF-platform-only (UNCERTAIN for full images).

name: VUACE deliberately vulnerable UEFI application
description: EDK2 app implementing real CVE patterns (CVE-2024-7344, CVE-2025-3052 classes) for controlled exploit practice.

name: ESET ML UEFI landscape (methodology; samples proprietary)
description: ESET paper describing ML exploration over large UEFI component collections (needles in haystack).
access_constraints: Methodology public; underlying millions of samples NOT public (UNCERTAIN/proprietary).

name: LVFS platform firmware corpus (policy index)
notes: INDEX: not redistributable wholesale; point researchers to LVFS/OEM terms.
